scope.blocking: Only GET /student/me and POST/PATCH /student/security/change-password bootstrap exceptions; strict403 initial flag then402 no-access, including former STU-07 subscription read exception

mail.adapter: Resend HTTPS POST /emails; fixed host, text-only OTP,5s timeout, no redirect, provider idempotency key by challenge UUID
mail.boundary: HTTP200 only after provider acceptance and active challenge acknowledgement; unconfigured503. Network outside transaction. Unknown timeout may still deliver; code valid until expiry/superseded. No plaintext persistence/background resend.
mail.providerChoice: Resend recommended in optional async question; proceeded with announced assumption, no provider/account configuration performed

privacy.audit: actor_id/action/recorded_at and resource id only; success or committed DENIED, no passwords/OTP/login-email values/cookies
privacy.avatar: Owned VERIFIED JPEG/PNG/WebP<=2MiB, bounded authenticated S3 read, MIME+signature checks, no-store/nosniff/CSP, relative endpoint rather than signed capability
privacy.metadata: Legacy sessions return empty strings; socket IP may be proxy address, untrusted forwarded header ignored
privacy.phone: No student phone mutation/verification API added
